title: Dreams Representing a Desire for Communal Human Connection?
content: Why do my dreams often involve being on a college campus with **large** test halls or **giant** class auditoriums, living at ocean-side resorts in vague foreign countries, and walking down long, expansive beaches? (College/school dreams are not usually stress-oriented). Why do many of my dreams involve being in a foreign country or city, walking around shopping squares, going in and out of cool shops or gift shops, and exploring movie theatre/mall hybrids? Why do I frequently dream about flying and airports that feel like large mega-malls, and why do childhood friends or people I haven’t seen since elementary or middle school often appear in these dreams, even though I don't think about them in my waking life? I spend a lot of my waking life thinking about these worlds in my dreams and why these locations feel so comforting, real, and magical in dreams despite being kind of bored by them in real life. I'm very introverted in real life and hate shopping, but in my dreams, being in public and going shopping is all I seem to do. Similarly, I hate to travel and am not big of vacations, but so many of my dreams involve being in a seemingly almost like European city (foreign for me, a Canadian) on vacation with my family. Do these locations represent a desire for a communal human connection in some way? They are usually locations bustling with people and maybe is a manifestation of an unconscious desire to be actively living and participating in a thriving system. - Sorry if this is kind of a ranting post. I am just kinda shocked about the discovery that other people are similarly affected by similar dreams and wanted to make this post.
